'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Alex O'Shea LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' QMCWTF
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
